source: NASA PCoE N-CMAPSS DS01-005, first original HDF5 member in dataset 17. Actual source is a simulation under real flight conditions. The measured feature schema differs from the competition's 24 inputs; this is an independent test of maintenance decisions under real end-of-trajectory labels, not a score of unchanged competition checkpoints.
order: Freeze before extracting the HDF5 target or opening labels. Use the published dev/test unit partition. Sort dev units by SHA256 of the ASCII string nc-field-v1/<integer unit ID>, use the first ceil(n/2) as source, the remaining dev units as the reference fleet, and every test unit as a service unit. No per-unit model overrides. One row per whole flight, mean of measured sensor X_s and operating-condition W columns, no virtual sensors, health labels, unit ID, flight number or dataset identity as predictive inputs. Consecutive physical flight cycles only. Simulate simultaneous starts; reference RUL becomes available strictly after its terminal flight number. Notify a reference measurement at each whole completed flight, withholding all future cycles. Service answers used after predictions are sealed. If split or schema unavailable report it.
fixed_toolbox: Source models: always-source-median, ridge with source-only standardization alpha 1, 100-tree random forest depth 6 seed 17, mean of the ridge and forest. Project cold start and fixed first tool is forest. Repeat existing project selection logic: after actual reference-unit completion release five evenly spaced historic records of that unit (at most five if short), compute per-tool MSE on those rows, weights one per device, select the lowest cumulative mean independently at a release. Tie by forest, ridge, median, half. Also include choice frozen after first feedback. Additional shared-tool mature backtest adaptation ranks tools by MSE on most recent finished reference unit. This is a regression model/tool-selection adaptation, not author's classification H-LLM. Score a fixed full-return refit on same five samples per completed reference plus source data, total source and target weight each half, fixed forest hyperparameters. Also score a gated arm that uses exactly that candidate when it improves on previous completed reference units not used for its construction; alternate finished units for training and confirmation and include an always-use-identical-candidate arm. If no independent confirmation, issue the incumbent.
scoring: Per-issued-flight pooled RMSE cycles, each service engine and worst engine, share before any usable feedback, number of fits and labels, choices and actual changed service rows. Require at least 1 percent gain versus the original forest and strongest fixed control and mature adaptation, worst device no more than 1 percent worse. Report separate limits where only one or no earlier failed reference was available. No choosing a different DS file or split after inspecting scores.
